verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. `SlowFirstOrderEdge.edgeDistance a y0 X = min 1 (min (log (X/a)) (y0 + 3 - log X))` is the paper's δ with X_a = a and the outer radius named by its logarithm, X_b = exp(y0+3): log(X_b/X) = log X_b − log X = (y0+3) − log X. The other three forms are the same min in the logarithmic coordinate y = log X: `ActiveAnnulusWeight.edgeDistance a b y = min 1 (min (y−a) (b−y))` with a = log X_a, b = log X_b, and `LeadingStressWeights.distance` / `BaseResidual.activeDelta` compose it with Real.log. Second difference: the paper states the formula only for X_a < X < X_b, whereas every Lean definition is total and returns a nonpositive value outside the annulus; all uses found restrict X to the annulus beforehand (e.g. stressX_weighted_jets quantifies X ∈ Ico (exp(y0+3−b)) (exp(y0+3))), and `ActiveAnnulusWeight.edgeDistance_pos` proves positivity exactly on Ioo a b.
